tracks.description:
An experimental classical album, exploring the use of a graphical score created by the frottage of a weaving sculpture by Amanda Buckley. Each work on the album respresents an attempt to recreate the rubbing into music in a different way.

'The Weight of Air' was created for an exhibition of the same name, by Amanda Buckley - shown in the Webb Gallery at QCAD (Griffith University, Brisbane) in September/October 2026.

enrichment.summary: A dense string orchestra sustains slow, dissonant swells in a reverberant space, building a brooding, cinematic atmosphere without percussion or a steady pulse.

tracks.title: Katabasis I
